title: UniFi console identity and managed set (site.yaml)
description: One per console. Editor-only: unifi-reconcile validates the per-resource files, not this one. It exists so VS Code stops applying SchemaStore's Ansible Playbook schema, which claims every file named site.yaml.

name.description: Label for output and pre-change captures.

base_url.description: Integration API base, local or via the Site Manager connector proxy. May contain {hostId}, filled from host_id.

host_id.description: Site Manager hostId. Required when base_url contains {hostId}.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key itself never goes in YAML.

verify_tls.description: false only for a self-signed LAN hostname.

network_version.description: Asserted against GET /v1/info before anything runs. Quote it, or YAML may read it as a number.

managed.description: Per resource type, the names this tool may write. The second signature on top of presence in the resource's YAML file.
